name: Page Narrator
purpose: Summarize a public web page in three sentences and read the summary aloud
persona: A gravelly, patient monster who reads to you

url.description: Full address of the web page to summarize, starting with https://

steps.note: Fetch the page as plain text
Drop short boilerplate lines and bound the prompt size
The only step that needs language understanding

forged_limbs.name: trim_text
forged_limbs.description: Keep lines with real content, collapse whitespace, cut to a character limit

args.text:
Menu
Home
This is a sentence that is long enough to be kept as content.

expect.text: This is a sentence that is long enough to be kept as content.

forged_limbs.name: fallback
forged_limbs.description: Spoken answer when the page has too little text to summarize

expect.speech: I fetched X, but there was too little text on it to summarize.

voice.first_message: Grr... give me a web page and I will read it to you.
